question: v05
q: Petrol's killing me. How much more am I paying than a year ago?

transcript.answer:
Petrol is **13.5% more expensive** than a year ago. That's the August 2026 figure, the latest in the ABS monthly CPI, compared with August 2025.

In index terms, automotive fuel was 112.95 in August 2026, up from 99.49 a year earlier. On an $80 fill, that's roughly $10.80 more for the same amount of fuel.

The price has been swinging a lot. It was down 7.3% year on year in June 2026, then jumped 13.5% in August. Prices rose sharply in March and April 2026 (+24.2% and +18.6%), then dropped back through June. The CPI covers all automotive fuel, so your own pump price may differ depending on the grade and where you buy.
